title: Marriage Improvement
description: Strengthen your marriage with better communication, quality time, and mutual appreciation

habits.title: Daily Check-In
habits.description: Ask about partner's day and share yours

habits.title: Express Gratitude
habits.description: Tell partner one thing you appreciate

tasks.title: Schedule Date Night
tasks.description: Set aside weekly time just for two of you

tasks.title: Discuss Love Languages
tasks.description: Learn each other's preferred ways to receive love

tasks.title: Plan Weekend Activity
tasks.description: Choose something fun to do together

warnings: Relationships require consistent effort from both partners
Communication is key - don't assume your partner knows what you need
Small gestures matter more than grand ones
Seek couples counseling if serious issues arise
fallback_message: I found a marriage improvement template! This plan will help you strengthen your relationship through better communication and connection.
